description: Shared utility functions and types for memory search tools in the openclaw project, including schema definitions, context resolution, and error handling.

methods.name: loadMemoryToolRuntime
methods.description: Loads and caches the memory tool runtime module asynchronously.

methods.name: resolveMemoryToolContext
methods.description: Resolves the memory tool context based on provided configuration and session key.

methods.name: getMemoryManagerContext
methods.description: Retrieves the memory manager with optional purpose, returning either the manager or an error.

methods.name: getMemoryManagerContextWithPurpose
methods.description: Retrieves the memory manager with specified purpose, returning either the manager or an error.

methods.name: createMemoryTool
methods.description: Creates a memory tool instance with specified parameters and execution logic.

methods.name: buildMemorySearchUnavailableResult
methods.description: Builds a standardized result object indicating memory search is unavailable, with error details and guidance.
